paper_title: I Don't Know Explicit Modeling of Uncertainty with an [IDK] Token
caption: : Tradeoff between and for different parameter combinations. We annotate each data point with its corresponding value.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the tradeoff between IDK recall (y-axis) and IDK error rate (x-axis) for four different configurations of a model, with each data point annotated by its corresponding value. The x-axis, labeled "IDK error rate," ranges from 0.0 to 0.25 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The y-axis, labeled "IDK recall," ranges from 0.1 to 0.6 on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. Four lines are plotted: a blue solid line with 'x' markers representing "No ℒ_FP-reg; fixed λ," a green dashed line with triangle markers for "No ℒ_FP-reg; adaptive λ," an orange solid line with 'x' markers for "With ℒ_FP-reg; fixed λ," and a red dashed line with triangle markers for "With ℒ_FP-reg; adaptive λ." The blue line starts at (0.0, 0.1) and ends at (0.25, 0.5), increasing steadily. The green line begins at (0.0, 0.1) and ends at (0.20, 0.5), also increasing steadily. The orange line starts at (0.0, 0.1) and reaches (0.15, 0.5), showing a steeper initial rise before plateauing. The red line begins at (0.0, 0.2), rises sharply to (0.05, 0.5), and then remains flat at 0.5 for the rest of the range. All lines exhibit an increasing or flat trend in IDK recall as IDK error rate increases, with the red line achieving the highest recall at the lowest error rate.
